name: Tavily
description: Tavily lets agents search the web, extract the content of pages, and crawl or map a site. Each user signs in to their own Tavily account through the browser, and searches use that account's credits.

prompts.text: Search for this week's news about EU AI regulation and summarize it with sources.
Extract the pricing table from the vendor's pricing page.
Map the documentation site and list the pages about authentication.

apps.name: Tavily
apps.description: Web search, page extraction, and site crawling, over Tavily's MCP server with browser sign-in.
